summary: Feed s099_single is degraded: APM tool port (10 Gbps) is overloaded by microbursts peaking at 12.81 Gbps (128% of capacity, 2 intervals over 80% threshold). All other checks (duplicates, encrypted share, VLAN, one-way, packet drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering aggregated/bursty traffic peaking at 12.81 Gbps in 1ms intervals to a single 10 Gbps APM port without load balancing or buffering. Two intervals exceeded the 80% overload threshold, hitting 128% of port capacity, indicating sustained microburst oversubscription at the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will suffer buffer overruns and indiscriminate packet loss during bursts, causing incomplete transaction traces, inaccurate latency/error calculations, and missed application performance degradations despite needing both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Hash-based load balancing spreads microbursts across 2x10G APM ports while keeping both directions of each flow together (required by APM), eliminating drops without filtering or truncating data.
